business.description: AksharChem (India) Limited is an integrated manufacturer of dye intermediates, pigments, and inorganic chemicals with backward integration into H-Acid. The company is a leading exporter of Vinyl Sulphone and CPC Green, and a fast-growing player in Precipitated Silica for tyre, rubber, and specialty applications.

outlook.statement: Cautiously optimistic for FY 2026-27; green shoots visible with gradual improvement in demand from paints & coatings, packaging, construction, automotive, tyres, and personal care industries; precipitated silica tailwinds strong due to EV/SUV/premium tyre demand, China-plus-one sourcing, and green tyre adoption
Dye intermediates: signs of stabilisation and gradual recovery as textile exports improve with inventory normalisation in Europe and US; healthy domestic demand from apparel and home textiles

Pigments: better positioned than dyes with resilient demand from paints, coatings, plastics, printing inks, packaging, construction, automotive refinishing; specialty/high-performance/environmentally compliant grades likely to outperform commodity pigments

Precipitated silica: next growth engine driven by tyre applications (green tyres, fuel efficiency, EV/premium tyres) and non-tyre applications (industrial rubber, footwear, rice rollers, agrochemicals, animal feed, specialty chemicals); China-plus-one sourcing becoming permanent

The Dyes & Pigments industry witnessed a gradual revival during the year, supported by favorable market conditions and enhanced demand across key customer segments. The Company's Silica business also remained stable, aided by improved capacity utilization and operational efficiencies. The Company expanded its market presence in Dyes intermediates by exploring and developing new customers in India and export markets, including Taiwan and South Korea, and for Silica business developing new export markets, including Sri Lanka, Russia, and Turkey. These efforts are expected to further strengthen the Company's global footprint and diversify its export base.

The Company has entered in the new geography namely Turkey, Vietnam, Srilanka, Russia etc. The Company is regularly conducting Sales & Operations Planning Meeting for identifying the issues and resolving them in an efficient and timely manner. During the year the Operating Cash flow of the Company has improved by effective utilization of working capital. The Company is ensuring sustainable performance even though there remains high vulnerability in raw material prices. We believe that our performance will be back on track, once the situation of geopolitical instability and global economy start improving. Further, with increased capacity utilization, company is reaching out to all markets in tire and rubber industry with parallel efforts for increased capacity creation during the year. New products requirements as per various demands of customers are being studied to expand product portfolio in coming years.

The Central and State Rules under the Labour Codes are yet to be notified and, upon such notification, the Company will reassess and recognise the impact, if any, on employee benefit obligations in accordance with applicable accounting standards
